evals.prompt: Review this described chart: a 3D bar chart compares defect rates of 4.8% and 5.1%, starts the y-axis at 4.7%, and concludes that a new training program caused the increase. Red and green identify the two factories.
evals.expected_output: Flags the exaggerated truncated bar scale, perspective distortion, color-only encoding, and unsupported causal claim. Recommends concrete alternatives such as a zero-based bar or clearly labeled dot plot, flat marks, direct labels or non-color cues, and appropriately cautious language.

evals.prompt: Critique our customer-retention dashboard. I have not shared an image, metric definitions, audience, or underlying data.
evals.expected_output: Does not invent dashboard defects or data. Asks a small number of focused questions or requests the artifact and key definitions, while offering a bounded checklist covering integrity, task fit, labels, accessibility, uncertainty, and evidential limits.

evals.prompt: A mobile dashboard overlays twelve monthly lines, repeats a legend on every card, has overlapping labels, and shows forecast lines without intervals. Suggest the three highest-value improvements for executives comparing regions.
evals.expected_output: Prioritizes a comparison-friendly design such as shared-scale small multiples, direct or selective labeling with redundant legends removed, and explicit forecast uncertainty. Accounts for mobile legibility and explains tradeoffs rather than only prescribing cosmetic changes.
